name: I Wanna Love You Cat Trend: Your Pet Sings the Viral AI Selfie
blurb: The I Wanna Love You cat trend is the viral AI clip of October 2026: a cat in a suit films a night selfie, sings "I Wanna Love You" into the camera, throws a paw in the air and falls back onto the grass with its legs up the wall.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 13 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same front-camera selfie at night by the lit tennis courts behind the chain-link fence, the same concrete path, the grass and the low concrete wall, the same night light, the same camera moves, framing, timing and moves, one continuous take with no cuts. The ONLY change: the orange tabby cat in the plaid suit who films itself and sings is now the pet in [Image 1].

SELFIE MODE, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT - the most important rule: the PET FILMS ITSELF for all 13 seconds, and the whole video is its own selfie view, exactly like [Video 1] - one unbroken take, no cuts, filmed as one single full frame. We ARE the selfie camera: nothing that holds it is ever seen - only the pet's own front leg reaching toward the lens from the bottom-left corner of the frame (the viewer's left), exactly like the leg in [Video 1] - the SAME front leg on the SAME left side of the frame for all 13 seconds, never switching sides. Its other front leg is empty, and it is the one that rises high in the air. The camera moves ONLY because the pet moves its outstretched front leg, exactly as in [Video 1]: in front of its face while it sings, then rising higher over its head while it bends backward, further and further, until it lies on its back on the grass and the camera looks straight down at its face. The whole vertical 9:16 frame stays filled.

DIVISION OF SOURCES - follow this strictly:
- From [Image 1] take ONLY the pet: the same species and breed, head shape, muzzle, eyes, ears, fur colors, fur length, markings and body shape as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner instantly recognizes it, also in the close-ups and when it lies back. Only the head, the face, the ears, the fur and the paws change: the pet keeps the costume of the original cat in every frame, the dark green and purple plaid suit jacket, the white patterned shirt and the navy bow tie with white polka dots, from the first second to the last. The front leg that holds the selfie camera and the hind legs that rise up the wall have the pet's own fur from [Image 1]. Never drift back to the cat of the original video: NO orange fur and NO ginger tabby stripes unless [Image 1] shows them. If [Image 1] shows a dog or another animal, that animal films itself in the same place with the same moves, with its own muzzle, ears, teeth and tongue.
- From [Video 1] take the PLACE, the costume, the PERFORMANCE - the moves, every facial expression, every move of the camera, the singing mouth - and the TIMING, exactly, beat by beat as written below. The pet performs [Video 1]'s moves with its own face and body; the cat in [Video 1] never appears.

BEAT BY BEAT - copy [Video 1]'s moves, timing and facial expressions exactly. The camera is ALWAYS in the pet's outstretched front leg (the left side of the frame); the other front leg stays empty. The eyes and the mouth copy the cat in [Video 1] frame by frame: the same half-closed, soulful squint, and the mouth open wide on the long notes and closed when the cat's mouth is closed:
[00:00-00:01.5] the camera comes up out of the dark to its face, chin up, cool and smooth; sings.
[00:01.5-00:05.0] close to the lens with the lit tennis courts behind, head swaying, eyebrows lifting; sings, the camera tilting down a little to the path and the grass.
[00:05.0-00:07.0] the other front paw starts to rise; sings with feeling.
[00:07.0-00:09.5] the other front paw high in the air, head tilted, eyes squeezed, the mouth wide open on the long notes; the camera rises and looks down at it.
[00:09.5-00:10.5] leans back against the low concrete wall, the raised paw comes down to its chest.
[00:10.5-00:13.0] lies back on the grass at the foot of the wall, the camera straight above looking down at its face, the head tipped back, the hind legs rising up the wall behind; belts straight up into the lens with the mouth stretched wide open.

ACTION: one continuous 13-second vertical 9:16 front-camera selfie video with no cuts, filmed from the pet's own outstretched front leg the whole time. Every frame shows the pet from [Image 1].

Real live-action footage, one continuous take, clear facial features, a stable face, no distortion, no deformation, real animal anatomy, the same pet in every frame, the same costume, the same fur.

Anatomy rules: one head only. Two hind legs and two front legs, furry paws covered in the pet's own fur, no extra legs or paws, never human hands. Exactly one animal.

Avoid: a white studio background, the selfie front leg switching to the right side, a phone in the frame, the back of a phone, a camera watching the pet from outside or from the side, a mouth out of sync with [Video 1], the orange tabby cat from [Video 1] appearing, a bowl-cut wig, a curly moustache, tinted round glasses, a green turtleneck, a gold chain, a camera that floats on its own, a second person filming, a different face, a heavier or thinner body than in the photo, human hands, fingers, bare skin, cuts, jump cuts, panels, black bars, borders, captions, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks, people, extra animals, extra limbs, morphing, facial distortion.

NO black tailcoat, NO red waistcoat, NO red cravat. NO big ginger sideburns, beard or moustache unless [Image 1] shows them.
- From [Video 1] take the PLACE, the PERFORMANCE (the moves, the facial expressions, the camera, the singing mouth) and the TIMING, beat by beat. The man in [Video 1] never appears.

BEAT BY BEAT - the eyes and the mouth copy the man in [Video 1] frame by frame, the mouth open wide on the long notes:

Real live-action footage, one continuous take, clear facial features, a stable face, normal human body structure, the same person, clothes and hairstyle in every frame. One head only, on the person's shoulders; two arms, two legs, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person.
